# Korhogo — Mauk Tenieb

> Korhogo, by Mauk Tenieb: concept albums, the 18 avatars of the Korhogo Fauna, lore. Experimental Hip-Hop, Illbient, IDM, Experimental Dub.

> Transmedia Underground Worldbuilder. Korhogo — a SciFi world [Jorge Luis Borges, William Seward Burroughs, Evald Ilyenkov...] — proliferates through the 18 avatars of the Korhogo Fauna. Genres? Experimental Hip-Hop, Concept Albums, Illbient, IDM, Experimental Dub — also: RPG, Games, Videos, Pictures, Collaborations, Literature (massive diary).

> Korhogo is Mauk Tenieb's fictional world; the Korhogo Fauna are its 18 inhabitants, the Masks. Korhogo also names a city in Ivory Coast and a Senufo cloth; Mauk Tenieb's Korhogo stands apart from both.
